fields.description:
The AWS review-bot holds a persistent tickets clone that a redeploy does not refresh, and it writes on every Gerrit vote. Make the clone self-converge after the epoch guard has landed, and fix the deploy path so later ensure-script changes reach the box automatically. Session log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** contains the measured facts.

## Why

The clone lives on the EBS-backed external volume declared in `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`. The generated entrypoint in `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot:127-149` clones only when `${REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_DIR}/.git` is absent, so a normal redeploy preserves any divergent history. The entrypoint invokes `reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` outside the PAT block, so convergence must still run when `REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT` is unset.

`infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh:50-69` currently configures the repo-local identity and runs the ensure registry, but does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset a divergent persistent clone. The bot uses `REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always`; its artifact writer runs after the Gerrit vote and catches store errors inside `src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py:56-166`, while the call site is `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py:719`. Convergence failure must remain best-effort and must never undo or wedge an already-cast vote.

## Deployment bootstrap

`infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:90` omits `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` from `BOT_PATHS`. The deploy decision at `:276` and rsync at `:334` therefore cannot deliver a first commit that changes only these scripts. This ticket depends on A6-0a and lands **after A6-0a**, as its own independently reviewable Gerrit change.

After this scripts-only change merges, perform the documented one-time hand-deploy from `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md`: update `/var/lib/rebar/mirror`, install the merged `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` into `/opt/rebar` while preserving owner `502:502`, and start `rebar-autodeploy.service`. The newly installed `BOT_PATHS` then detects the ensure-script change and performs the normal rsync/build/health workflow. Future ensure-script changes self-deploy without another bootstrap.

## What

1. In `reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh`, guard `git fetch origin tickets`. If it fails because credentials are absent or the origin is unreachable, keep the local tip byte-for-byte unchanged, log the failure, and return success so `set -eu` cannot abort an already-cast vote.
2. After a successful fetch, classify the persistent clone:
   - equal: keep the local tip;
   - local strictly ahead: keep the local tip so a failed-push artifact remains retryable;
   - local behind: fast-forward/reset the dedicated branch to `origin/tickets`;
   - histories diverged: atomically create `refs/rebar/reviewbot-preconverge/<old-tip>` pointing to the exact old local tip, verify that recovery ref, then reset the dedicated `tickets` branch to `origin/tickets`. Log the old tip, new tip, and recovery ref.
   The retained ref makes any failed-push artifact commit recoverable and observable; it is never silently discarded. Normal `rebar._store.sync.reconverge` is deliberately not sufficient for the cross-epoch case: A6-0a makes it refuse an epoch-mismatched union, while this dedicated boot-time path must adopt the authoritative rewritten branch before the bot writes again.
3. Add `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` to `autodeploy.sh` `BOT_PATHS`. Preserve execution outside the PAT block and preserve best-effort vote safety.
4. Hand-bootstrap the first deployment after merge, then record the deployed main SHA or image digest, the successful autodeploy/health receipt, a deployed-runtime epoch-mismatch refusal probe, and the persistent-clone convergence result.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [code-verifiable] Given real temporary clones with divergent local and `origin/tickets` histories, the ensure script resets the dedicated `tickets` branch exactly to `origin/tickets`. Tier: shell integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Before that divergent reset, the script creates a verified `refs/rebar/reviewbot-preconverge/<old-tip>` recovery ref pointing to the exact old local tip, and the old commit remains reachable through that ref. Tier: shell integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The divergent case logs the old tip, new tip, and recovery ref. Tier: shell integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An equal clone preserves its exact local tip. Tier: shell integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A merely-behind clone converges exactly to `origin/tickets`. Tier: shell integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A strictly-ahead clone preserves its exact local tip so an unpushed artifact remains retryable. Tier: shell integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Equal, behind, ahead, and diverged cases leave no merge or stash state. Tier: shell integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A failed or credentialless `git fetch origin tickets` exits best-effort success, preserves the exact local tip, and emits an operator-readable warning. Tier: shell integration with a failing remote.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] With `REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT` unset, the generated entrypoint still invokes ensure/convergence against an existing clone outside the PAT block. Tier: shell integration through the generated entrypoint.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` appears in `autodeploy.sh` `BOT_PATHS`.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A path-classifier test proves a change to `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` selects the review-bot deploy branch.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An injected rebar store write failure after `post_vote` leaves the Gerrit vote recorded. Tier: unit at the artifact/caller boundary.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] That injected store failure returns through the existing best-effort artifact path without undoing or wedging the vote. Tier: unit at the artifact/caller boundary.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The merged A6-0b SHA or image digest is recorded on this ticket before closure.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The one-time hand-bootstrap command exits are recorded on this ticket before closure.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A successful autodeploy and health receipt is recorded on this ticket before closure.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Deployed-runtime epoch-mismatch refusal output is recorded on this ticket before closure.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Persistent-clone convergence old tip, new tip, and recovery ref are recorded on this ticket before closure.

## Scope

`infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh`, `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot` tests only if required for generated-entrypoint coverage, and focused tests.

Scope: S. Depends on A6-0a; lands after A6-0a as its own change.
